items.reason: The Google Meet fallback dereferences an undefined mainHostDestinationCalendar when the destination array is null or empty, crashing event creation.
The update/delete fallback searches for the already-falsy externalCalendarId, losing the configured destination calendar.
Non-calendar references lose result.credentialId, preventing later meeting lifecycle operations from finding the credential.
The optional push drops collective hosts' destination calendars when the organizer's destinationCalendar is null.
The inverted billing condition assigns the organization slug when billing is enabled and omits it when billing is disabled.
Location editing rebuilds references from update results that lack externalId, losing externalCalendarId and breaking later calendar routing.
The recurring bulk deletion runs once per calendar reference, duplicating deletion calls for remaining occurrences and causing API errors.
